```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  dco-check:
    if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify DCO Sign-off
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

          # Get list of commits in PR excluding merge commits
          COMMITS=$(git rev-list --no-merges ${BASE_SHA}..${HEAD_SHA})

          MISSING=()
          for COMMIT in $COMMITS; do
            MESSAGE=$(git show -s --format=%B $COMMIT)
            if ! echo "$MESSAGE" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              MISSING+=($COMMIT)
            fi
          done

          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ The following commits are missing DCO sign-off:"
            for COMMIT in "${MISSING[@]}"; do
              echo "  - $COMMIT"
            done
            echo
            echo "Please add a Signed-off-by line to each commit message."
            echo "Example:"
            echo "  Signed-off-by: Your Name <you@example.com>"
            echo
            echo "You can amend the commits locally and push again:"
            echo "  git commit --amend -m \"<commit message>\\nSigned-off-by: Your Name <you@example.com>\""
            echo "  git push --force-with-lease"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All commits have DCO sign-off."
          fi
```
